_comment: Schema: RestroomExperimentsFile in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 2b. Written by ml/restroom/export_results.py from ml/results/restroom/runs/*.json, pipeline.json (row R7 and `pipeline`) and layers.csv (`layers`). Rows with isReal false are placeholders with null metrics ('not run yet'). `served` names the row the app's Match runs; null until the API runs the pipeline. `reference` holds the numbers published by the IOAI committee on their test set (Leaderboard B); they are not our runs.

reference.note: Published by the IOAI 2025 committee for the Restroom Icon Matching task, top-1 matching accuracy on their test set (Leaderboard B). Not our runs.

runs.changed: baseline: zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16, second most similar gallery image (IOAI baseline)
backbone: ViT-B/32 instead of ViT-B/16, still zero-shot
fine-tune last 1 block of ViT-B/32, two models, two-step matching (IOAI reference recipe)
as R2, last 6 blocks fine-tuned (the reference solution's setting)
gender probe: logistic regression on frozen ViT-B/32 embeddings; match = most similar candidate of the opposite predicted gender (the API's rule)
two-step pipeline, no training: SIFT and a pixel check find the crop's original, colour histogram and zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/32 find its partner

servedNote: The app's /restroom/match does not run the two-step pipeline yet: it ranks the gallery by zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/32 similarity and picks the most similar sign of the opposite predicted gender (0.47 on test, `gender_filter_zeroshot` in R1). `served` becomes "R7" when the API runs the pipeline (task C-8).

pipeline.selection: highest mean train-episode top-1, then validation top-1, then the simpler row; test read once
pipeline.trainEpisodesProtocol: 200 episodes of 30 training restrooms, random query gender, gallery = their 60 originals
